tasks.short: Review manuscripts for publication in books and journals.

steps.what: Review manuscripts for publication in books and professional journals.

tasks.design: The anthropology teacher reads the manuscript and writes the review for the book or the journal. Submitting that review is the same act, done by the teacher. No second entry of the review is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The recommendation rests on the teacher's reading of unpublished scholarship, and a wrong call is hard to undo once the editor acts.
tasks.enabler_now: Class amplify and a high model score are priors. The digest's marking, bibliography, syllabus, and letter tools cover other tasks in this group. They do not review an unpublished manuscript for a book or a professional journal, so this task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: Method, evidence, and fit with the field have to be judged on this manuscript.
tasks.human_edge: Standing behind a publication recommendation after reading the manuscript.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The anthropology teacher still reviews the manuscript and submits their own review.

reach.task: Review a history manuscript for a journal
reach.learn: Learn the sources and the period a history referee is expected to judge.

evidence.claim: A publication review of an unpublished manuscript is the teacher's own reading and recommendation. Marking and bibliography tools for other tasks in this group do not do that review.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the anthropology teacher reviews the manuscript and submits their own review. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If the manuscript file is missing, the teacher asks the editor and still reads it. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this journal asks the teacher to retype the review into a second portal after writing it elsewhere. That retype is not in this statement.
research_questions: Does this teacher write the review only in the journal's own form, or also keep a separate local file that is then retyped?

already_counted.description: Reading the manuscript and writing the review remain in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The teacher still reads the manuscript and writes the review in the same act. No second entry goes away. A conservative case is a long book manuscript that takes the whole review, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events.

steps.what: Participate in campus and community events.

tasks.design: The anthropology teacher still attends the campus or community event in person. Showing up is the task. No list or second notice is part of that attendance.
tasks.previous_blocker: The event is a particular room, audience, and moment, and the teacher has to be there.
tasks.enabler_now: Class human. The digest says lecturing, research, and advising stay human, and its automate list is examinations, papers, bibliographies, and syllabi. Attending a campus or community event is none of those, so this task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: The teacher has to speak with the people who came, in that place, on that day.
tasks.human_edge: Being present with the campus or community audience.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The anthropology teacher still attends the campus or community event.

reach.task: Take part in a campus sociology event
reach.learn: Learn who the event is for and what the teacher is asked to say there.

evidence.claim: Taking part in a campus or community event is in-person presence. The group digest's automate list does not cover that attendance.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the anthropology teacher attends the campus or community event in person. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If an invitation is missing, the teacher still attends when asked in person. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this campus expects a written note after the event. That note is not in this statement.
research_questions: Is participation only attendance, or does this teacher also prepare a public talk as a separate artefact?

already_counted.description: Attending the campus or community event remains in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The teacher still attends the event. A conservative case is a community event that is entirely in person, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on committees dealing with policies, departmental matters, and academic issues.

steps.what: Serve on academic or administrative committees.
On the committee, deal with institutional policies, departmental matters, and academic issues.

tasks.design: The anthropology teacher still sits on the academic or administrative committee and deals with the policy, the departmental matter, or the academic issue in the meeting. No second entry of that discussion is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The committee's view depends on the people in the room and on the case in front of them.
tasks.enabler_now: Class human. Serving on the committee is the meeting and the judgement in it. The digest's automate list is examinations, papers, bibliographies, and syllabi, which are other tasks, so this task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: Institutional policy, a departmental matter, and an academic issue are argued with colleagues, not applied from one rule.
tasks.human_edge: Taking a view in the committee with the colleagues who share the decision.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The anthropology teacher still serves on the committee and deals with its issues.

reach.role: Area, Ethnic, and Cultural Studies Teachers, Postsecondary
reach.task: Serve on a committee about a programme rule
reach.learn: Learn which rule that committee may change.

evidence.claim: Committee service on policy and academic issues is a meeting the teacher attends and argues in. The group digest does not move that meeting to a tool.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the anthropology teacher serves on the committee and deals with its issues in the meeting. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If the agenda is missing, the teacher still takes part. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this committee also requires the teacher to write the minutes. Minutes are not in this statement.
research_questions: Does serving on this committee include writing the decision record, or only the meeting itself?

already_counted.description: Serving on the committee and dealing with its issues remain in those steps.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both steps stay with the teacher. A conservative case is a committee meeting that is entirely spoken, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform administrative duties, such as serving as department head.

steps.what: Perform administrative duties, such as serving as department head.

tasks.design: The anthropology teacher still performs the administrative duty, including serving as department head, by directing the department in person. A workflow shape score is not a second entry this statement names, so the direction stays with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Department-head direction depends on the people, the week, and the matter in front of the teacher.
tasks.enabler_now: Class human. Directing a department is coordination and judgement. A workflow shape score and a partial software score are priors, not a second entry the statement names, so this task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: The teacher has to choose what the department does this week and say so to the people who do it.
tasks.human_edge: Directing the department as its head, with the people who report there.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The anthropology teacher still performs the administrative duty, including serving as department head.

reach.task: Coordinate a programme review with a department
reach.learn: Learn which decisions stay with the department head.

evidence.claim: Serving as department head is directing people. A shape score for workflow software does not name a second entry in this duty.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the anthropology teacher performs the administrative duty, including department-head direction, with the department. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If a roster is missing, the teacher still directs the people in the room. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this department head also retypes staffing numbers into a second system. That retype is not in this statement.
research_questions: Which administrative duties in this department are the teacher's own direction, and which belong to a faculty office?

already_counted.description: Performing the administrative duty, including department-head direction, remains in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The department-head duty stays with the teacher. A conservative case is a week of in-person direction with no second system entry, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Manuscript review, campus and community events, committee service, and department-head duties stay with the anthropology teacher. The week stays in those duties. No decision right moves.
